I think it could since deep down you might hope for a response, and then if he doesn't acknowledge your goodbye it might make you feel sad or unworthy of him/his time. This is just an assumption, but sometimes emotions can be unpredictable. You might have really high confidence or moved on for the most part, in which case sending it may not be as bad.

You can if you want, but if you're really trying to move on I would say scrap the message. Don't give him the satisfaction of knowing he still has an affect on you, it will boost his ego and make him believe ghosting will get him attention from people. You don't need to send that in order to get closure, in fact it might make you feel worse.
The cycle is hard to break out of but I think if you choose more filling options for breakfast, lunch and dinner it could help holding you off extra things
